    "Limited customization options compared to other tools",

    "Free plan limitations (e.g., single project) can be restrictive"

  "overall_experience": "This Gerente likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for managing basic graphic design projects within a small team. The simplicity of adding tasks and tracking deadlines was probably appreciated, though they might have encountered some initial friction with manually adding tools and the default settings for events. The limited customization and single-project constraint on the free plan could be a minor frustration for a new user exploring options."
